mapper.select: SELECT DATA_PROVIDER , API_URL , DATA_FORMAT , API_EXPL FROM RAWAPIINFO ORDER BY DATA_PROVIDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RAWAPIJDBCINFO ( ID , JDBC_URL , JDBC_DRIVER , CONN_POOL , JDBC_ID , JDBC_PW ) VALUES ( #{ID}, #{JDBC_URL}, #{JDBC_DRIVER}, #{CON_CNT}, #{JDBC_ID}, #{JDBC_PW} )

INSERT INTO RAWAPIINFO ( API_ID , API_URL , API_SVC , IS_QUERY , IS_PATH , DATA_FORMAT , DATA_PV_GP , DATA_PROVIDER , API_EXPL , USER_KEY , USER_AUTH , KEY_NAME , PAGE_COL_NM , TC_COL_NM , JDBC_ID ) VALUES ( #{API_ID}, #{BASE_URL}, #{API_SVC}, #{IS_QUERY}, #{IS_PATH}, #{DATA_FORMAT}, #{DATA_PV_GP}, #{DATA_PROVIDER}, #{API_EXPL}, #{AUTH_KEY}, #{AUTH_SECRET}, #{KEY_NAME}, #{PAGE_COL_NM}, #{TC_COL_NM}, #{JDBC_ID} )
